name: framework-setup
description: Set up a project for Brush Frame (step 4): Gitflow branches, merge rules, CI with unit tests, ticket-key commits, AI review, a ticket system, secrets protection and the project's rule file (AGENTS.md in Codex).

interface.shortDescription: Set up a project, step by step
interface.longDescription: Brush Frame is a human-led way to build software with AI. This helper does its setup step for a project: GitHub branches and merge rules, CI with unit tests, ticket keys in commits, AI review, a ticket system and the project's rule file. Then it takes your first idea to a brainstorm or a design. You log in and decide; the AI does the rest.
defaultPrompt: Set up this project with Brush Frame.
